title: Dockbot
blurb: You're a loader-bot on the night shift. Shove every cargo crate onto a glowing dock pad. You can only push — never pull, never two at once — so think before you shove.
blurb_keys: Arrow keys move; Z undoes, R resets.
blurb_touch: The d-pad moves; Undo takes a move back, Reset restarts the level.
hint_keys: Arrow keys / WASD to move · walk into a crate to push it · get every crate onto a pad
hint_touch: D-pad to move · push every crate onto a pad
resumed_note: Resumed shifts don't set a fewest-moves record.
